rows.note: The viewBox attribute is refitted from 0 0 600 200 to 20 70 440 60, the box the painted content actually occupies.
The stray rect's x and y move from 140,140 to 6,78, inside the 100 by 100 viewBox.
The text content is shortened to a string that fits the declared 120-unit caption box.
font-family="system-ui, sans-serif" is added to the text element, so the label no longer resolves to the renderer default.
The shared id="title" is namespaced per graphic to chart-revenue-title and chart-cost-title, so the two accessible names stop colliding.
role="img" is added to the svg element and a title element is inserted directly beneath it.
The aria-label attribute is dropped from the svg element, leaving title as the only accessible name.
keySplines changes from "0.34 1.56 0.64 1" to "0.34 0 0.64 1", bringing both control points inside [0,1].
transform-box: fill-box is added to the style of the second rect, the one whose correct twin element sits beside it in the same file (R9).
A one-line internal style plus a still twin circle are inserted, so under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce the animated element is swapped out.
The CSS kill switch is replaced by an element swap plus a set element, because a CSS motion property does not reach a SMIL timeline (R4).
pathLength="100" is declared and the dash and offset drop from 300 to 100, so the dash matches the geometry instead of guessing at it.
The one block holding the script element, the onclick handler, the foreignObject and the javascript: href is replaced by inert geometry.
The internal DTD subset is replaced by a bare public DOCTYPE, which declares nothing and must read clean.
xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" is added to the svg element, so the file is a standalone document an img delivery can render.
The d attribute is rewritten so every command carries the coordinate count its grammar requires.

Structural, not one edit: the defect is a reference that dangles inside one file, and the clean form is a sprite sheet whose symbol ids are addressed from hosts/sprite-host.html. The clean state cannot be reached by editing a line - it is a different file shape, and its point is that an id with no in-file reference is correct there.

The two stacked circles become a single even-odd path, so the inner region is a real hole with alpha 0 instead of near-white paint (S5). Step 1.2 of road-to-svg-from-a-live-session: the row now carries the SOURCE it is registered against, because the rule asks what the source shows under the near-white region and nothing used to read it.
The second value in the animate values list drops a line segment, so both values carry the same commands in the same order.
The external image href and the external url() paint reference are replaced by local geometry and the file's own gradient id.
A defs line defining both referenced ids is inserted ahead of the two references, so neither url(#id) nor use href="#id" dangles.
The data: raster and the dummy one-segment path are replaced by a real triangle path, so the file is a vector rather than a wrapper around a bitmap (D3).
The bar path is rewritten onto the incumbent set's 24 grid - 2-unit stroke, 3 units of padding - instead of 1.7 and 1.5.
The bare img is wrapped in a picture element carrying a source with media="(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)", the only place that route can live (R5, E4).
A still twin circle and the matching media query are added to the page, giving the inline SMIL a route it did not have (R10, DQ4 fixture for step 1.3).
The page's CSS kill switch is replaced by an element swap, because a CSS motion property leaves the SMIL timeline running under reduce (R4, D8).

The only id="a" sits inside a comment, so it is not in the document. A pattern over the raw text reads it as defined and reports the file clean; the element parser never saw it. Step 3.1 of road-to-svg-review-followups.
</g></path> closes in the wrong order. Both tags are present and correctly spelled, which is why a flat element list cannot see it and only a tree can. Step 3.1.
The <title> names the group it sits in, not the graphic, so the graphic has no accessible name. Parentage, which no pattern over the text decides. Step 3.1.

controls.note: A mark built only from rect, circle and polygon. The presence check in logo-generation step 5 fails it; the vector-honesty family must count those primitives as vector geometry and report nothing (D3's false red).

stroke-dasharray="90 150" with no pathLength is an intentional spinner pattern, not a guessed length. The prototype's static regex fired here (R12), which is why draw-on dead time is an engine reading in 2.1 and never a static rule.

Painted bbox 18 by 12 inside a 24 by 24 viewBox - a fill ratio of 0.375, which is designed padding. The prototype's global 0.5 threshold read it as loose (R12); at the icon-class threshold of 0.30 it must read clean.

The same shape as the near-white-hole row, registered against a source that shows WHITE PAINT in the middle. The owner chose that colour, so the rule must stay silent — the measured false positive this control exists for fired six times on exactly this shape.

surgical.note: Sibling paths with no grouping. The bad edit removes the allowed face path and also shifts the base path's d from y 52 to y 56.
Two transformed groups. The bad edit empties the allowed face-group and also changes the neighbouring hat-group's transform from translate(10 4) to translate(14 4).
Two use elements instancing one symbol. The bad edit repoints the allowed use-right at tile-alt and also moves use-left's x from 10 to 16.

conversion.note: The ground truth for the raster-to-vector sub-case (6.1b). The raster is rendered FROM this file by Chromium at test time, so the geometry of every region is known exactly and no third-party brand image is committed (S1, S4). Flat two-stop gradients and no text element, so a re-derivation does not depend on the renderer's font stack. Regions: mark, mark-hole, wordmark, slogan - and mark-hole is a real hole with alpha 0, not near-white paint (S5).

support.note: The animated file delivered as a CSS background. Delivery mode is what 1.5 grades and what 2.1 records as reduced_motion: not_witnessable.
Addresses assets/unused-defs.clean.svg's symbol ids from outside the file, which is why that twin must read clean.
Delivery payload for hosts/img-delivery.html and hosts/css-bg-delivery.html.
The static source the picture route selects under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

raster_conversion_tolerance.note: The one accepted point on record (S13), used as a floor rather than an aim: the fixture raster is rendered from a flat-gradient vector, so a conversion of it must do at least as well as a conversion of a photographic brand sheet did. A run needing more than five scored passes to reach it fails (6.1b).
